bug: Something does not behave as the rules or the pages say
enhancement: A rule, engine or tooling proposal from the feature form
flaky: A test that passed only on a retry
follow-up: Work a session left: a loose end of a stage or a review
from-report: Filed by the operator from a player's bug report in the panel's Feedback tab
ops: A portal, a setting, the deployed app
proposal: An idea nobody asked for yet, filed by /proposals
red-main: Opened by CI while main is red
red-nightly: Opened by CI while the nightly is red
